summary: Created the additive file CanAlgComplete.lean bundling per-fragment algebraic completeness behind a single generic structure. Phase 1: `CanAlgComplete P` structure (Ax + complete + sound fields, universes pinned .{u,u}) plus packaged theorems `canAlgComplete_iff` and `canAlgComplete_haValid_iff`. Phase 2: three instances by reuse only — `canAlgCompleteIsBotFree` (MinPropAxiom via total MPL.hilbert_alg_complete), `canAlgCompleteIsOrBotFree` (ConjImpAxiom via LowerSet B + conjImp_brouwerian_complete), `canAlgCompleteIsImpTopOnly` (ImpAxiom via mplAxiom_iff_impAxiom routing through IsOrBotFree → LowerSet B). Rasiowa free implicative algebra declined as planned. Phase 3: barrel import added, FragmentGeneric residual note (lines 40-53) updated to point at CanAlgComplete and correct the Rasiowa framing. No new mathematics: all instances are term-level compositions of existing sorry-free theorems.
